title: East Nashville Cottage
description:
Our space is a well appointed, newly renovated historic 1940’s post WWII veteran’s home in the heart of East Nashville. 
 Walk to Slow Hand Coffee, Pearl Diver, Tower Deli, Starbucks, Publix. Around the corner from Folk, Audrey, R.H. Stranger. Just 3 miles to Nash Conv. Center, 1 mile to historic 5 points. Sleep well on one-heck-of-a luxurious “Kluft” mattress complete with down comforter. Let stress melt away as you relax in the hot tub. This place has everything you need and nothing you don’t.

The space
Guests are welcome to use the full space during their stay.
In addition to the king bed, there's a fold down couch in the living room

Guest access
Full space
